# Every crate vendored into Sift, with its version.
#
# This file is the third dependency gate of docs/build/workspace.md: a dependency
# added to the workspace, or a transitive one appearing with an upgrade, is reviewed
# rather than absorbed. A diff to this file is that review, and it is deliberately
# noisy — the threshold is low on purpose.
#
# Regenerate with `cargo xtask deps --bless`.
